thread:
Erica (Mktg): FYI noticed a big spike in unassigned leads for EMEA this morning on the handoff dashboard, ~120 overnight.
Mike - SalesOps: yikes. was it enrichment timeout or owner-rule failure?
Olivia CS: majority show enrichment webhook returned 502 or timed out, so the HubSpot owner-rule never evaluated the enriched company segment.
Juan G: that explains it. our round-robin gate requires the segment property present otherwise it falls through.
Erica (Mktg): proposal: add a short "overnight fallback" workflow in HubSpot that assigns to an EMEA-night pool after a small delay so leads aren't unowned for hours.
Mike - SalesOps: pragmatic. suggest 10-15 minutes delay to let enrichment complete, then fallback if still no owner. add a property flag so we can track and revert when enrichment finishes.
Olivia CS: agree. also create an SLA rule: if still unowned 2 hours -> page SDR lead and create a ticket in handoff queue.
Juan G: implementation details: HubSpot workflow with Delay(15m) + If owner IS_EMPTY AND timezone IN EMEA -> set owner = "EMEA-night-fallback" and set property inbound_fallback = true. Mirror logic in SFDC with Flow.
Mike - SalesOps: will also add a TTL reassign webhook: enrichment job will call endpoint to swap owner to real_owner_id and set inbound_fallback = false once company data present. snippet: PUT /contacts/:id { properties: [ { property: "owner", value: "{{real_owner_id}}" }, { property: "inbound_fallback", value: "false" } ] }
Erica (Mktg): can we partition fallback pools by segment? e.g., EMEA-enterprise-night vs EMEA-trial-night
Juan G: yes, add condition contact.segment == "enterprise" -> EMEA-enterprise-fallback, else -> EMEA-trial-fallback.
Olivia CS: need playbook note for SDRs: how to treat fallback leads, quality checks, and reassign expectations. I'll draft.
Mike - SalesOps: rollout plan: 1) implement in HS sandbox, 2) SFDC flow mirror, 3) canary in UK for 48h, 4) monitor metrics: unassigned_count, fallback_rate, reassign_rate, SLA_violations, manual_reassigns.
Erica (Mktg): add dashboard tile for fallback_count and time_to_real_owner. I'll update playbook and ping SDR ops.
HubSpot Sync Bot: enrichment job enq-2026-03-22-089 queued, webhook 8812 delivered.
Juan G: operational note: our enrichment lambda has a token-bucket throttle overnight. We could increase capacity for a brief window but prefer fallback to avoid ripple effects.
Mike - SalesOps: also add a label to fallback-assigned leads so reporting excludes them from immediate MQL conversion metrics until reassigned or validated.
Erica (Mktg): agreed. Q: should we auto-unassign fallback owner when real owner is set, or prefer manual review before releasing?
Olivia CS: auto-reassign is fine but add audit trail and an indicator that it passed via enrichment. SDRs can review top hits periodically.
Juan G: I'll add the webhook logic to include historical note: previous_owner: EMEA-night-fallback, new_owner: {{real_owner}}.
Mike - SalesOps: drafting the HS workflow now, will post JSON diff here for review. planning to flip on canary tonight at 22:00 UTC for UK.
Erica (Mktg): thanks all. big win if we can bring overnight unassigned to ~0 without surfacing noise. schedule a 1-week retrospective after canary. :calendar:
Olivia CS: adding retro to calendar and will monitor quality metrics.
Mike - SalesOps: posted draft in #marketing, ping me for access. :eyes:
Juan G: thumbs up.
